channel.title: ALTRENDAT
channel.description: What the world is searching for, explained with sources

item.title: Maryland and Michigan suspend penalties for farmers using tax-exempt red-dyed diesel
item.description: Governors Wes Moore and Gretchen Whitmer have authorized farmers and loggers to use tax-exempt diesel on public highways through December 31.

item.title: William Contreras leads Brewers past Dodgers to clinch commanding 2-0 NLCS lead
item.description: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a 7-4 victory over the Los Angeles Dodgers in Game 2 of the NLCS on Monday to take a 2-0 series lead.

item.title: Super El Niño smashes sea surface temperature records before expected December peak
item.description: Record-breaking sea-surface temperatures in the central Pacific have reached unprecedented levels as the current El Niño event continues to strengthen.

item.title: Pakistan Snatches Series With 82-Run Rout Of Visiting Sri Lanka Side
item.description: Pakistan secured the three-match series by defeating Sri Lanka by 82 runs in the second T20I at Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium.

item.title: Josh Hazlewood Snatches Career-Best Figures To Clinch Australia Victory In Durban
item.description: Josh Hazlewood led Australia to a 1-0 series lead after South Africa lost their final four wickets for five runs.

item.title: Four red cards follow Shamrock Rovers victory over Bohemians at Tallaght
item.description: Shamrock Rovers moved six points clear at the top of the Premier Division after a 2-1 win over Bohemians witnessed a post-match mass confrontation.

item.title: SpaceX Spectrum Buy Wrecks Telecom Stocks As Starlink Targets Mobile Market Dominance
item.description: SpaceX agreed to purchase a nationwide 800 MHz spectrum portfolio from Grain Management to expand Starlink into mobile services, triggering steep declines for major U.S. carriers.

item.title: Coventry City Routs Newcastle 4-1 to Clinch First Premier League Home Win
item.description: Coventry City climbed to 14th place in the Premier League after a 4-1 victory against Newcastle United at the CBS Arena.

item.title: Status Yellow wind warning hits Ireland with gusts expected this Wednesday morning
item.description: Met Éireann issued a Status Yellow wind warning for Donegal, Galway, and Mayo starting at 6am on Wednesday, October 14.

item.title: Breaking Bad star RJ Mitte dies at age 34 in Texas
item.description: The actor who portrayed Walter White Jr. in the hit television series passed away on Monday in Brownsville.

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo Nets 981st Career Goal as Al-Nassr Routs Neftchi Fergana 3-1
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo scored in Al-Nassr’s 3-1 victory over Uzbekistan’s Neftchi Fergana on Monday after a missile-related security delay forced a one-hour kickoff postponement in Riyadh.

item.title: NFL Overtime Rules: How 10-Minute Periods Decide Games in 2026
item.description: The 2026 NFL season uses 10-minute overtime periods where both teams are guaranteed a possession to match or exceed the opponent's score.

item.title: Dodgers Star Shohei Ohtani Faces Power Shortage During Struggles Against Milwaukee Brewers
item.description: Shohei Ohtani is battling a postseason slump and injury concerns while hitting a .188 average.

item.title: Christian Yelich returns to Brewers designated hitter spot for NLCS Game 2
item.description: The Milwaukee Brewers have restored Christian Yelich to the lineup for Monday’s second game of the NLCS against the Los Angeles Dodgers.

item.title: Breaking Bad star RJ Mitte dies at 34 in Brownsville Texas
item.description: RJ Mitte, best known for playing Walter White Jr. in Breaking Bad, passed away at 34 on Monday.

item.title: Hackers Force French Supermarket Fridges To 50C In Unprecedented Cyber Attack
item.description: Hundreds of supermarkets across France suffered massive food losses after hackers remotely heated refrigeration units overnight.

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo Starts For Al Nassr In Crucial AFC Champions League Clash
item.description: Al Nassr hosts Uzbekistan's Neftchi Fergana today at Al-Awwal Park in Matchday 2 of the 2026–27 AFC Champions League Elite.

item.title: Alex Eala Rallies at East Lake Before Wuhan Open First Round Clash
item.description: Alex Eala faces Chinese qualifier Shi Han on Monday to conclude the night session of the 2026 Wuhan Open.

item.title: Mohamed Belloumi 74th-minute strike salvages draw for Hull against visiting Everton
item.description: Hull City and Everton drew 2-2 at MKM Stadium as Mohamed Belloumi scored the equalizer in the second half.

item.title: Kerry Kennedy Authors New Memoir Detailing Her Mother Ethel Kennedy's Extraordinary Life
item.description: Kerry Kennedy releases a new memoir, Ethel Kennedy: The Extraordinary Life and Bold Legacy, which explores her mother's enduring resilience and family history.

item.title: Georgia Holds Top Spot While Texas Plummets After Ugly Rivalry Defeat
item.description: Georgia retained its number one ranking in the NCAA Re-Rank 1-138 following Week 6, while Texas dropped to seventh after losing to Oklahoma.

item.title: J.J. McCarthy storms onto field for Giants debut in Washington clash
item.description: Quarterback J.J. McCarthy made his New York Giants debut Sunday, recording five snaps and two carries during a 27-27 tie against the Washington Commanders.

item.title: New HDT Owner Kenny Habul Targets Iconic Reimagined Performance Cars in Bathurst
item.description: Owner Kenny Habul has acquired the HDT Special Vehicles brand and plans to build a new performance car headquarters at Mount Panorama.

item.title: Sengkang MP Jamus Lim hospitalized with pneumonia after catching Influenza A
item.description: Workers' Party MP Jamus Lim was admitted to hospital over the weekend after his blood oxygen level dropped to the low 90s following Influenza A that developed into pneumonia, forcing him to suspend his regular duties.

item.title: Tyler Huntley takes the reins as injured Lamar Jackson misses Falcons clash
item.description: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson has been ruled out of Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons due to an ankle injury.

item.title: Tua Tagovailoa primed to start for Falcons following Michael Penix rib injury
item.description: Tua Tagovailoa stepped in during overtime of Sunday's 30-23 loss to the Ravens after starter Michael Penix Jr. sustained a rib injury.

item.title: Red alert Delhi: heavy rain and 60 kmph winds batter capital
item.description: The India Meteorological Department issued a red alert for all 11 Delhi districts on Monday due to heavy rainfall, thunderstorms, and intense winds.

item.title: 12 Million Pound Must Be Won Lotto Jackpot Results Drawn Saturday Night
item.description: Players await the results for the 12 million pound National Lottery jackpot draw held on Saturday, October 10.

item.title: Lewis Koumas earns first Premier League start as Liverpool hosts Manchester City
item.description: Liverpool faces Manchester City at Anfield today with Lewis Koumas starting in the absence of Cody Gakpo and Alexander Isak.

item.title: Darius Cooper 62-yard touchdown pass snatches Eagles lead against London-based Jaguars
item.description: Wide receiver Darius Cooper hauled in a 62-yard touchdown pass from Jalen Hurts to put the Philadelphia Eagles ahead of the Jacksonville Jaguars in London.

item.title: Police car mounts Geylang Bahru kerb and crashes into metal road barrier
item.description: A 31-year-old police officer is assisting with investigations after his patrol vehicle hit a road divider on October 10.

item.title: Roma Travel North to Face Como in Pivotal Serie A Title Clash
item.description: Roma faces Como at Stadio Giuseppe Sinigaglia in a crucial match as both teams contend for the top of the Serie A standings.

item.title: Celtic Aim for Top Spot as Motherwell Stretches Squad Depth Amid Injuries
item.description: Celtic faces Motherwell in a Scottish Premiership match at 12pm, with the visitors looking to reclaim the league lead.

item.title: Singapore Rolls Out Haze Subsidies Capping Treatment Costs At Ten Dollars
item.description: Health Minister Ong Ye Kung activated subsidized medical care at clinics and polyclinics starting October 12 as air quality declines.

item.title: Dow Surges 400 Points as Wall Street Breaks Losing Streak Friday
item.description: Major stock averages rebounded on Friday as AI trade jitters eased and tech stocks recovered their footing.

item.title: The Diplomat Returns for Season 4 Alongside Ben Affleck Thriller Animals
item.description: Netflix debuts the fourth season of The Diplomat and the crime thriller Animals during the week of Oct. 9–15.

item.title: Matthew Renshaw's career-best 190 total topples South Africa in Durban Test
item.description: Matthew Renshaw struck 190 runs to lead Australia to 390 all out in the first Test at Kingsmead as South Africa closed day two at 27 for one.

item.title: Max Verstappen Snatches Singapore Grand Prix Pole Position Following Sprint Race Victory
item.description: Max Verstappen secured pole position for Sunday's Singapore Grand Prix after also winning the sprint race on the Marina Bay circuit.

item.title: Patrick Bamford nets double as Sheffield United storms past Lincoln City 3-0
item.description: Sheffield United ended a three-game losing streak by defeating Lincoln City 3-0 at Bramall Lane.

item.title: 10-man Vancouver Whitecaps hold firm in tense 1-1 road draw against LAFC
item.description: Oliver Larraz scored for a shorthanded Vancouver Whitecaps side in a 1-1 tie against Los Angeles FC on Saturday night.
